# SkillWheel

**Tags:** `world-system`

The skill wheel: each skill tier is a node with an affinity per profession (which pulls it toward that profession on the rim) and a depth (how far from the centre it sits), plus what the tier unlocks.

> **Goal:** Draw skills as a wheel of professions with shared skills in the centre instead of a grid of tiers (Phase 271)

## Fields

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| ---- | ---- | -------- | ----------- |
| `id` | uuid | yes |  |
| `professions` | json | yes | Profession ids, in rim order |
| `professionSkills` | json | yes | { <profession>: [skills it is built from] } |
| `nodes` | json | yes | { "<Skill>:<tier>": { skill, tier, depth, affinity, requires, unlock } } |
